items.name: Oficina Open 2023
items.information:
# REGISTRO

A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos:


1. Conhecer as regras da WCA, pois é uma competição oficial;
2. Escolher os eventos a serem registrados com cuidado após revisar as guias Eventos e Cronograma. Preste atenção aos formatos das rodadas e seus cortes/limites;
3. Se inscrever através do site da WCA. A inscrição terá custo de R$ 25,00 pagos antecipadamente por meio de depósito bancário ou pix. Conta para deposito: Banco Itau | Ag. 7021 | CC 05400-7 -> Pix 103552998-01. O comprovante deve ser enviado ao email dos organizadores para aprovação da inscrição.
Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do e-mail antonio.cecchini@gmail.com e vicenzo.g.cecchini@gmail.com

------------

**REGISTRATION**

The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements:

1.	Being familiar with the WCA rules, since this is an official competition;
2.	Carefully choosing the events. Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind.
3.	Register through the WCA website.The registration fee is R$25,00 (registration+shirt) paid in advance by bank transfer or Pix. Registration at competition day will not be allowed.
Bank Account:  Itau Bank | Ag. 7021 | CC 05400-7 -> Pix 103552998-01.
4.	For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizers via email, (antonio.cecchini@gmail.com and vicenzo.g.cecchini@gmail.com)

items.name: National Capital Region A 2023
items.information:
### (EN)
## NCR 2023 Series

This competition is in a series with [National Capital Region B 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NationalCapitalRegionB2023). You will only be able to compete in *one* of these two competitions. Attempting to register for both competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.

## Mailing List

We are aware of the extremely high demand for competitions in Ontario. We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand and are regularly planning and announcing more and larger competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://speedcubingcanada.org/en) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. Thank you for your patience during this time as we work to scale up to the exciting growth of the cubing community.

## Competitor Requirements

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, you may want to look at the [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/files/WCA_Competition_Tutorial.pdf).

For new competitors, this video may help with competing. 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww&t=2s

Please see tabs for more information about the competition.

## Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

### (FR)
## Série NCR 2023

Cette compétition fait partie d'une série avec [National Capital Region B 2023] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NationalCapitalRegionB2023). Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à *une* de ces deux compétitions. Si vous tentez de vous inscrire aux deux compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée.

## Liste de diffusion

Nous sommes conscients de la demande extrêmement élevée de compétitions en Ontario. Nous travaillons dur pour répondre à cette demande et nous planifions et annonçons régulièrement des compétitions plus grandes et plus nombreuses. Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les médias sociaux et/ou [joindre notre liste de diffusion] (https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. Nous vous remercions de votre patience pendant cette période où nous nous efforçons de faire face à la croissance passionnante de la communauté du cube.

## Exigences pour les compétiteurs

Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les concurrents doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Si vous n'avez jamais participé à une compétition, vous pouvez consulter le [Tutoriel de la compétition de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/files/WCA_Competition_Tutorial.pdf).

Pour les nouveaux concurrents, cette vidéo peut les aider à participer à la compétition. 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww&t=2s

Veuillez consulter les onglets pour plus d'informations sur la compétition.

## Avis de droit à l'image

Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.name: Larissa Spring Open 2023
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdm8xIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--dd65eb480c4a2f6ae601106b518d7da158eeb179/336963227_762958098547893_38350618552278990_n.jpg)

Larissa Spring Open 2023 είναι ο δεύτερος διαγωνισμός για φέτος στην Ελλάδα. Στη σειρά διαγωνισμών Road to Greek Nationals, θα εστιάζουμε πάντα σε 2 events που δεν είναι ακόμα πολύ γνωστά στην Ελλάδα. Σε αυτό το διαγωνισμό θέλουμε να φέρουμε τα αγωνίσματα του 3x3x3 blindfolded και του Skewb πιο κοντά στους συμμετέχοντες. Ο στόχος είναι να διεξαχθεί το πρώτο ελληνικό εθνικό πρωτάθλημα προς το τέλος του τρέχοντος έτους. Μέχρι τότε, όλα τα events θα είναι οικεία στους συμμετέχοντες.

Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε σε μία ακόμα γιορτή του cubing!

Παρακαλώ διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. 

Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registrations στο site της wca ΚΑΙ να γίνει η πληρωμή της εισόδου με την κάρτα σας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. 

[Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg)


Larissa Spring Open 2023 is the second competition this year in Greece.
In the next "Road to Greek finals" competitions, we will always focus on 2 events that are not yet very well known in Greece. In this competition we want to bring the events 3x3x3 blindfolded and Skewb closer to the competitors. The goal is to make the first Greek National Championship towards the end of this year. By then, all events will be familiar to the competitors.

Grab your cubes, study the regulations and attend the greek feast of cubing!

Please read the following tabs very carefully!

Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site and pay the fee as described in the nexts tabs.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaHNYIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--36307c5514bc8fbbcd5f7d0435fb449ed0337df6/tpc-banner-text.png)

- Bay Area Speedcubin' is proud to partner with [West Coast Cubing LLC](https://www.facebook.com/WestCoastCubingLLC) and [CubersLive](https://www.facebook.com/CubersLive) to bring another competition to Northern California with a **focus on the live-stream experience and a head-to-head spectacle!**
-  *If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.*
- We will be assigning judging assignments to competitors for the group before or after their own competing groups. Please check your personal competitor cards when we assign them a week before the competition date for relevant info.
- Competitors can bring 1 guest for free to the competition! If they would like to bring a 2nd a more guests, we are charging $5 per extra guest via paypal at the front desk.
- **Spectators not accociated with the competition may still pay the $5 spectator fee to attend and watch the competition up close and personal!**

# Any donations we receive from the WCA website or other platforms will be directly given back to our 3x3 finalists! Please consider donating to support our high-performing speedcubers!
